outcome: Perinatal outcomes (preterm birth, small for gestational age newborns)
Mode of delivery (spontaneous labor, Cesarean section)
cohort: 932 singleton pregnancies (115 adolescents and 817 adults) at a Clinical Hospital in Tetovo, Republic of Macedonia, from January 2016 to December 2018
finding: Adolescent mothers experience higher rates of urinary tract infections, anemia, preterm birth, and small for gestational age newborns compared to adult mothers.
mod_finding: The study found that Cesarean sections were less common among adolescents compared to adult mothers (25.2% vs. 33.5%).
